risks.risk: The VPN tun E2E needs a real device or the emulator grant. The public emulator does not deliver guest traffic to the tun.
risks.handling: Use host Rust tests, the ArkTS host specs, and the SOCKS e2e on the emulator. Record the tun E2E as a device-blocked item with the exact blocker.

risks.risk: The repository and the HarmonyOS SDK are owned by w2h. The session user is red.
risks.handling: Run build and test commands as w2h with sudo -u w2h. Keep generated files under directories owned by red.

risks.risk: 229 portable cases span 11 units and cannot fit one delivery window.
risks.handling: Work one unit at a time in parity order. Split into a follow-up batch if the work crosses two natural days.

risks.risk: Human design gates and the result gate are pending. The a01 skill does not allow the executor to sign for the reviewer.
risks.handling: Publish every layer page and keep the gates pending. Claim completion only after the reviewer exports accepted conclusions and the user says the delivery is accepted.

risks.risk: 56 Android-only cases cannot be ported as they are.
risks.handling: Record a platform decision per case. Implement a HarmonyOS equivalent where the public SDK supports one. Accept the rest as not portable with the reason.

risks.risk: Test-first order was compressed for the new modules: implementation and specs were written in the same wave. Red is recorded only for the three changed existing suites.
risks.handling: Recorded in checks/red.txt and completion.md. The host suites and the clean build are the executed evidence.

risks.risk: The emulator runs x86_64 while the app shipped arm64-v8a only, so the on-device suites could not install.
risks.handling: Resolved: the app build now carries arm64-v8a and x86_64, and the x86_64 Rust staticlib is built. SslocalNativeTest and SocksE2eTest passed on the emulator. VpnE2eTest stays a real-device test.
